name: Lesche of the Knidians
text: The Lesche of the Knidians (or Cnidians) was a lesche, i.e. a club or meeting place, at the sanctuary of Apollo in Delphi. Today, it has been mostly destroyed; the only surviving parts are some architectural relics. It hosted two famous paintings by the famous painter Polygnotus the Thasian, namely the Capture of Troy and the Nekyia.

depictions.name: Lesche of the Knidians
depictions.text: The Lesche of the Knidians was a meeting and dining place located within the Sanctuary of Delphi in Greece.
